//: Remotion builds this folder with its own esbuild bundler, never with Astro's Vite pipeline. It is excluded from the root tsconfig because Astro's strict config resolves the `remotion` package's exports map to the wrong declaration file and reports every named export as unexported — the render itself succeeds regardless. This config gives the folder the resolution Remotion actually expects, so an editor still type-checks it correctly.
